sokkel-tui.note: The look for the time series panel only; its glyphs (spark-levels, swatch) from glyphs.json.

summary: The look every chart kind shares, drawn from rows: a chart takes rows, a kind that says how to draw them and the fields to read, and draws in the theme it sits in. Quiet axes in border with their labels in muted-foreground, grid lines across the value axis a step lighter than the border, series in the theme's categorical order (or the colors a spec names, or each run state's status color with statuses), a line one and a half wide, bars at most 28 wide, a tooltip on the popover's look with a swatch, a label and a figure per series, dashed lines across at a scale's steps and down at marked categories, and a legend beside the chart whose entries hide or emphasize their series. A figure that is not there is the dash, and is left out of a tooltip. A candlestick draws open, high, low and close per category, rises in good and falls in critical, with an optional volume panel, moving averages and zoom. This spec is the look and the shared behavior; the kinds (bar, line, area, donut and the rest) are not specified one by one yet, and the frame around a chart (title, menu, export, expand, data view, loading, empty and failed) is parts/dashboard-panel's.

anatomy.plot: The chart's box: it fills the box it is given (an app or a frame gives it a size) and draws on what is under it, with no ground of its own (backgroundColor transparent). The grid inside it keeps 4 at the start and the foot, 10 at the end and the top (more at the top while a marked category's label needs the room), and grows to hold the axis labels.
anatomy.axisLine: The category or time axis' line along the plot's foot, 1 wide in border; a value axis draws none. No ticks.
anatomy.axisLabel: An axis' labels, in the sans face at chart-text-size, in muted-foreground; a value axis hides labels that would overlap and writes its figures short, by the spec's format and unit. An axis' name at chart-text-size-small.
anatomy.gridLine: A line across the plot at each value-axis step, 1 wide, in the border mixed 65 percent into the card (oklab); category and time axes draw none.
anatomy.series: A series' marks in its color: the spec's colors for that name, else the spec's palette in order, else the theme's order (palette). A line 1.5 wide with its points hidden until hovered (5 across); an area under it fading from the color at 40 percent of the card to 4 percent (55 to 30 stacked), or solid; a bar at most 28 wide, its far corners rounded by a share of the radius; a point 7 across at 85 percent. A slice or a heatmap cell is edged in card.
anatomy.reference: A series the spec draws dashed: a reference, such as a target or the period before, as a dashed line 1.25 wide with no area or points.
anatomy.stepLine: Each step of the spec's scale after the first, a dashed line 1 wide across the plot at its value in the step's color (muted-foreground when it names none), its figure written at its end over the line at chart-text-size-small.
anatomy.markLine: Each of the spec's marks, a dashed line 1 wide down the plot at its category in the mark's color (muted-foreground when it names none), its label at its top at chart-text-size-small.
anatomy.axisPointer: While the pointer is over the plot: a dashed line 1 wide in muted-foreground at the hovered category, or a shade of muted-foreground at 14 percent behind its bars.
anatomy.tooltip: The hovered category's figures on the popover's look: popover ground, a 1 wide border edge, radius-md, elevation-pop, padded 10 across and 6 down, text.xs. The category over its rows at weight 450; a row per series with a figure: its swatch, its name, its figure at the end.
anatomy.tooltipSwatch: A row's swatch, 10 square, rounded radius-mini, in its series' color.
anatomy.tooltipLabel: A row's series name, in muted-foreground.
anatomy.tooltipValue: A row's figure at its end, 16 after the name at least, in the code face at weight 450 with tabular figures, in popover-foreground.
anatomy.legend: ChartLegend, beside the chart rather than in it: a wrapping row of entries 4 apart (list), or a list table of each series with its min, max, mean and current figure (table, parts/table's list variant, unframed).
anatomy.legendItem: An entry: a button holding its swatch and label (and its figure with figures), 24 tall, padded 6 across, 6 between swatch and label, radius-md, text.xs in muted-foreground; a finger tall below md. A press, Enter or Space hides or shows its series; hover or focus emphasizes it.
anatomy.legendSwatch: An entry's swatch, 10 square, rounded radius-mini, in its series' color; hollow (a 1 wide inset ring in the entry's ink) while its series is hidden.
anatomy.legendFigure: An entry's figure after its label, in the code face with tabular figures, in foreground.
anatomy.missing: A figure that is not there: left out of a tooltip (a null, or ECharts' own '-'), and drawn as the dash, —, where a figure is written: the data view's cells, a gauge's figure, a dual axis' tooltip, a legend table's figures.
anatomy.candleRise: The candlestick kind's mark per category: a body from the open to the close, 60 percent of the band and at most 14 wide, edged 1 wide in its own color, and a wick 1 wide from the low to the high. A category that closes at or above its open is a rise (candleRise), one below a fall (candleFall). The value axis fits the figures in view rather than starting at zero. A rise: closing at or above its open.
anatomy.candleFall: A candle that closes below its open, drawn as candleRise is, in the fall's color.
anatomy.ohlcBar: The candle drawn as a bar (ohlc style bars): a line 1.5 wide from the low to the high, a tick left at the open and one right at the close, each 30 percent of the band and at most 7 long, in the rise's or the fall's color.
anatomy.volumeRise: With ohlc volume: a bar per category in a panel under the candles, on the same category axis, a quarter of the height, named over its axis (fieldNames or the field); in its candle's color 45 percent into the card, its far corners rounded.
anatomy.volumeFall: A fall's volume bar, drawn as volumeRise is, in the fall's color 45 percent into the card.
anatomy.average: A moving average of the closes: a line 1.25 wide with no points, in its series color, missing until its span is full.

kind.does: How the rows are drawn. The same rows draw as any kind that reads their fields; a chart no kind draws becomes a new kind or an option on one, never a hand-built option.
kind.sokkel-ui: ChartProps kind, the keys of KINDS (kinds/index.ts)

label.does: What the chart shows, for a screen reader.

rows.does: The rows to draw; kept stable between renders, since a change builds the chart again.

fields.does: The fields to read, as a table's columns are picked: x, y, series, value, facet, path and the rest a kind reads; fieldNames names them for a reader.

palette.does: The color tokens series take in order when the spec names no color for them; the theme's order (SERIES_ORDER) by default, an app's own palette in its place.

colors.does: A color token per series or category name, over the palette; a token may carry an alpha (name/45).

statuses.does: true: every series or category named for a run state (succeeded, failed, running, queued, pending, waiting, cancelled, skipped, completed_with_errors) in its status color (status-<state>); or the app's own StatusMap, its colors good (good), critical (critical), warning (warning), info (info) and neutral (faint) or a run state's. A name in colors keeps its own token.
statuses.sokkel-ui: ChartSpec statuses (withStatuses in kinds/spec.ts, STATUS_CSS in lib/status.ts)

steps.does: A threshold scale ({ value?, color }): the steps after the first drawn as dashed lines across (stepLine).

marks.does: Lines down the chart at categories of x ({ x, label?, color? }): where a forecast starts, a release (markLine).

targets.does: Lines across the chart at values, { value, label?, color? }: each dashed, 1 wide, in its color token (muted-foreground by default), its label and value written at its end above it; the value axis reaches each where the figures do not. ChartSpec targets, ChartTarget.

ohlc.does: The candlestick kind's fields, { open, high, low, close, volume?, style? }: each category's open, high, low and close; volume, bars in a panel under the candles on the same axis (volumeBar); style candles (the default) or bars (ohlcBar). Several rows of one category make one candle: the first open, the last close, the highest high, the lowest low and the summed volume.
ohlc.sokkel-ui: ChartSpec ohlc, ChartOhlc (kinds/spec.ts); candlesOf in kinds/legend-candles.ts

averages.does: The candlestick kind's moving averages of the closes, one line per span in categories ([5, 20]), each named by the average word and its span (Average 5) and colored as a series in the palette's order (average).

zoom.does: The part of a linked or candlestick chart's shared axis in view at first, [from, to] in percent or the first and last category; it adds the zoom: a slider under the last panel, a drag across a panel, a pinch or Ctrl and the wheel, moving every panel together.

format.does: How a figure is written, in ticks, tooltips, the legend and the data view; unit is written after it.

hidden.does: The series hidden, held by the legend (or a frame) around the chart; hovered emphasizes one.

words.does: The chart's words over the English defaults (ChartSpec words).

legend.note: The list: entries 4 apart across, 2 down.

axisText.note: Axis labels, legend text drawn by ECharts, a tooltip's axis label (look.size.label).

axisNameText.note: An axis' name, a step's or a mark's label (look.size.small).

statText.note: A figure in a chart's middle, such as a gauge's or a ring's (look.size.stat).

statTextSmall.note: That figure in a small chart, a gauge on a phone (look.size.statSmall).

gridStart.note: The grid's room at the start (theme.ts grid.left).

gridEnd.note: The grid's room at the end (grid.right).

gridTop.note: The grid's room at the top (grid.top); with a labeled mark, chart-text-size-small and 12 (markRoom).

gridFoot.note: The grid's room at the foot (grid.bottom); it grows to hold the axis labels (outerBoundsContain axisLabel).

pointSize.note: A line's point, shown on hover (line.symbolSize).

barMaxWidth.note: A bar at most this wide (bar.barMaxWidth).

markCorner.note: A bar's or a cell's corner: this share of the radius token (look.corner).

chartLegendIcon.note: The swatch of the legend ECharts draws in a chart (legend.itemWidth, itemHeight); 14 between its entries (legend.itemGap).

sliceEdge.note: A pie or ring slice's edge in card (pie.itemStyle.borderWidth); a heatmap cell's is 1.

candleWidth.note: A candle, an OHLC bar or a volume bar at most this wide (WIDEST in kinds/candlestick.ts).

cells.width: Fills the box it is given.

plot.note: Dots in braille, two by four a cell (parts/time-series-panel's cells); the kinds other than lines and areas have no cells reading yet.

axisLine.note: A row of rule under the plot.

axisLabel.note: In muted-foreground, as many as fit without touching, the first and the last kept.

gridLine.note: grid-dot across at each value step.

tooltip.note: No floating box in cells: the hovered or focused category's figures are said in the status line (principle 23), each series' swatch, name and figure.

legend.note: A row of entries: the swatch glyph in the series' color, then its name; a hidden entry in its faded paint.

missing.note: The missing glyph where a figure is not there (principle 10).

rest.means: The series drawn in their colors, the axes, grid and lines quiet.

hover.means: The pointer over the plot: the axis pointer at the hovered category and the tooltip with its figures; over a series, it is emphasized (its points shown) and the others blurred. Over a legend entry: the entry on hover in foreground, its series emphasized.

blurred.means: Another series is emphasized: a line at 20 percent, an area at 4, a bar or point at 25.
blurred.reached: hover or focus on another series or its legend entry

focus.means: Keyboard focus on a legend entry: the focus outline in ring, focus-ring-width wide, drawn inside the entry; its series emphasized.

hidden.means: A series switched off by its legend entry: not drawn, its entry at 60 percent with its label struck through and its swatch hollow; in ECharts' own legend, faint.
hidden.reached: a press, Enter or Space on its entry; hidden

rest.note: theme.ts chartTheme axisLine.lineStyle.color, look.border (look.ts readLook: token('border')).
The first of the theme's order (SERIES_ORDER in look.ts): chart-2, chart-3, chart-4, kind-teal, kind-pink, kind-green, kind-blue, chart-5. A spec's colors, palette or statuses stand over it.
When the step names no color (kinds/axes.ts stepMarks, look.muted); dashed.
When the mark names no color (kinds/axes.ts categoryMarks, look.muted); dashed.
theme.ts tooltip.axisPointer: a dashed line, or a shade of muted-foreground at 14 percent behind bars.
tooltipMarkup in look.ts; elevation-pop under it. The category at weight 450.
In the code face, tabular figures.

hidden.note: Hollow: a 1 wide inset ring in the entry's ink.

rest.note: A rise's body and wick: tones in kinds/legend-waterfall.ts, rise: good, as a waterfall's rises; colors names another for the Rise word.
A fall's body and wick: tones in kinds/legend-waterfall.ts, fall: critical; colors names another for the Fall word.
A rise's volume bar: look.mix(the rise's color, 45) in kinds/candlestick.ts.
A fall's volume bar: look.mix(the fall's color, 45).

keyboard.does: Moves between the legend's entries, each a button.
Hides or shows the entry's series; focus on an entry emphasizes its series.

appText.label: What the chart shows, for a screen reader.
appText.fieldNames: What each field is called in a tooltip, an axis' name, the legend and the data view.

sokkel-ui: ECharts draws every chart (the library's one chart engine), on its canvas renderer; its core loads with the first chart, each chart type and component the first time an option draws with it, a kind's builder with the first chart of that kind, and the SVG renderer only for an export to SVG.

ECharts takes no CSS: useChartLook reads the theme the chart sits in (the page's, or a data-theme-scope's) and resolves each token to hex on a one-pixel canvas (readLook in look.ts), again when the scheme, the theme or a token override changes, once fonts have loaded. A server draws the chart's box alone.
The words are a private default object in kinds/spec.ts (WORDS, ChartWords), merged under the spec's words; the legend's in ChartLegend.tsx (WORDS, LegendWords).
The legend's table mode is a DataTable, loaded the first time a legend is drawn as a table.
Figures in the legend are written with en-US grouping until a locale arrives.
sokkel-egui: Draws charts with its painter (principle 15): no second engine.
